mutation(
  $payloadH: [ProductionHistoryCreatePayloadInput!]!,
  $payloadIT: [InventoryTransactionCreatePayloadInput!]!,
  $payloadDM: [ProductionSetupMaterialDeletePayloadInput!]!
){
  createProductionHistory(payload:$payloadH){
    id
    number
    actualLaborHours
    actualMachineHours
    actualSetupHours
    earnedLaborHours
    earnedMachineHours
    earnedSetupHours
    quantity
    includeProductionCounts
    externalId
    creditedAt
    occurAt
    assetData
    customData
    productionHistoryStatusId
    transactionTypeId
    workcenterId
    aggregationId
    distributionId
    distributionGroupId
    inventoryId
    kanbanCardId
    masterInventoryId
    productId
    productStrategyProcessId
    productionRunId
    scrapReasonId
    shiftId
    workOrderId
    workOrderProcessId
  },
  createInventoryTransaction(payload:$payloadIT){
    sourceQuantity {
      value
      unitId
    }
    sourceProductId
    id
  },
  deleteProductionSetupMaterial(payload: $payloadDM){id}
}
